meta.title: Household consumption expenditure by income quintile, Finland 2022
notes: Quintiles are formed on household disposable income per consumption unit (OECD scale), not gross salary.
Mean disposable income is a group mean, not a cut-off boundary.
Shares are of household consumption expenditure and may not sum to 100 because of rounding and unclassified items.
